title: SeBA: Semi-supervised few-shot learning via Separated-at-Birth Alignment for tabular data
abstract: arXiv:2605.08519v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning from scarce labeled data with a larger pool of unlabeled samples, known as semi-supervised few-shot learning (SS-FSL), remains critical for applications involving tabular data in domains like medicine, finance, and science. The existing SS-FSL methods often rely on self-supervised learning (SSL) frameworks developed for vision or language, which assume the availability of a natural form of data augmentations. For tabular data, defining meaningful augmentations is non-trivial and can easily distort semantics, limiting the effectiveness of conventional SSL. In this work, we rethink SSL for tabular data and propose Separated-at-Birth Alignment (SeBA), a joint-embedding framework for SS-FSL that eliminates the dependence on augmentations. translated_title: SeBA：基于“出生即分离对齐”的表格数据半监督小样本学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：在医学、金融和科学等领域中，表格数据的应用常面临标注样本稀缺的问题，同时存在大量未标注样本，这种场景被称为半监督小样本学习（SS-FSL）。现有的SS-FSL方法通常依赖于为视觉或语言任务开发的自我监督学习（SSL）框架，这些框架假设存在自然的数据增强形式。对于表格数据，定义有意义的增强方式并非易事，且容易扭曲数据语义，从而限制了传统SSL的有效性。在本研究中，我们重新思考了针对表格数据的SSL方法，并提出了“出生即分离对齐”（SeBA）——一种用于SS-FSL的联合嵌入框架，它消除了对数据增强的依赖。其核心思想是将数据分离为两个独立但互补的视图，并将一个视图的表示对齐到数据在另一个视图中的最近邻对应关系。
tldr: 本文提出SeBA框架，通过分离数据为互补视图并利用最近邻对齐，无需数据增强即可高效处理表格数据的半监督小样本学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SeBA, a joint-embedding framework that separates tabular data into complementary views and aligns representations via nearest-neighbor correspondence, enabling augmentation-free semi-supervised few-shot learning.
